sentences.en: It was a daring adventure, full of thrill and excitement.
sentences.zh: 这是一次大胆的冒险，充满了激动和兴奋。

sentences.en: The idea of seeing my mother thrills me very much.
sentences.zh: 见到妈妈的想法让我非常激动。

sentences.en: I can't tell you what a thrill it gave me.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法用言语表达那种激动的感觉。
